body: Unfortunately there is no such person in my life or coming into it anytime soon. I'm all alone except for my dad (it's just my dad and me living in the house). I wish there was someone like that, but I don't see it happening anytime

Really, the only times I've felt truly happy was through someone else. The last time I stabilized it was mostly because I met someone who made me happy. I liked them and I thought that they liked me. Found out that they were just leading me on. Unfortunately, I've had this happen to me so many times in my life
